cells.gaps: No source found shows a law, regulation or draft in Namibia that sets a condition for sending personal data abroad.
cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): [NAM-001] is a dated statement, from August 2026, that Namibia has no data protection statute and so no rule on cross-border transfers; it sets stage 1. [NAM-004] shows ratification of Malabo, which cannot lift a country with no transfer rule.
